Delia's New Book: 9 Ingredients to Change Our World

Posted on 7 Sep 2026 by Noreen Collins

Delia's New Book - Us: Nine Ingredients To Change Our World

Published by Canongate on 22nd October 2026.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:27
Instaread

Available in hardback, ebook and audiobook, the book marks a new chapter for Delia, whose influence has already transformed home cooking for generations. 

For decades, Delia taught Britain how to cook with confidence. Her straightforward, reassuring approach helped millions rediscover the basics of home cooking and removed the fear often associated with preparing food from scratch. Now she turns her attention from kitchens to communities, asking how ordinary people can reclaim their voice in modern politics.

In Us: Nine Ingredients To Change Our World, Delia reflects on lessons learned throughout her own life, exploring what it truly means to be human in an increasingly divided world. Through nine thoughtful and deeply personal essays, she introduces readers to influential political thinkers from both the past and present, while examining themes including kindness, justice, democracy, climate responsibility and the importance of community. The book also features a foreword by musician and political activist Brian Eno, alongside an afterword by Jamie Kelsey, a leading figure in the global citizens’ assembly movement.

Us: Nine Ingredients To Change Our World encourages readers to think differently about power, society and how political change can begin with ordinary people coming together.

Delia said:

“I have written this book in an attempt to find answers for ordinary people like myself who are realising the world under its present political systems is not functioning. Our societies have fallen into the hands of tyrants and billionaires who care nothing for the violations they inflict on the population. Neither do they care about the very grave and dangerous effects of climate issues.

What are the root causes of this chaos and disorder? How can we join forces in unity and solidarity in order to devise, create and initiate a politics of the people?”

Us: Nine Ingredients To Change Our World by Delia Smith will be published in hardback by Canongate on 22nd October 2026. Pre-order here

JOIN DELIA

Delia will be in conversation with The Times chief correspondent, Martin Samuel, as she discusses her new book, Us: Nine Ingredients to Change Our World. Drawing on a life rich in experience, Delia will reflect on what it means to be human, the values that bind us together, and why politics works best when it grows from the ground up.
